GenAiFunction.description: This topic allows an agent to apply a discount on a specific product in a quote and Update quantity of the product simultaneously. The agent provides the product name and discount percentage, and updates quantity and the system automatically updates the discounted value and the quanitiy of the product.
GenAiFunction.masterLabel: Apply Discount and Quantity of the product
GenAiFunction.progressIndicatorMessage: Applying Discount adn Updating the product
